title: Abraham's Calling
subtitle: From Ur of the Chaldeans to the land of promise
intro: A man of Mesopotamia hears a voice and walks west with his family and flocks. This is where the story of a chosen people begins.

stops.name: Ur
stops.note: Terah takes Abram, Sarai and Lot out of Ur of the Chaldeans, heading for Canaan.

stops.name: Haran
stops.note: They settle at Haran until Terah dies. Then the call comes: go from your country to the land I will show you.

stops.name: Shechem
stops.note: In the land of Canaan, at the oak of Moreh, the promise is given: to your offspring I will give this land.

stops.name: Bethel
stops.note: Abram pitches his tent between Bethel and Ai, and builds an altar.

stops.name: Memphis
stops.note: Famine drives him south into Egypt.

stops.name: Hebron
stops.note: Back in Canaan he settles by the oaks of Mamre at Hebron.

stops.name: Gerar
stops.note: He journeys toward the Negeb and lives for a time at Gerar.

stops.name: Beersheba
stops.note: Abraham plants a tamarisk tree at Beersheba and calls on the name of the LORD.

stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.note: The test on Mount Moriah: the land where, a thousand years later, a temple would stand.

title: The Exodus
subtitle: Out of Egypt, through the sea, to the mountain
intro: Six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children. A road through the sea, a mountain wrapped in fire, and forty years of desert.

stops.name: Rameses
stops.note: The people of Israel journey from Rameses to Succoth.

stops.name: Etham
stops.note: They camp at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.

stops.name: Pi-hahiroth
stops.note: Turn back and camp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea.

stops.name: Red Sea crossing
stops.note: The waters are a wall to the right and to the left.

stops.name: Marah
stops.note: Three days without water; and the water at Marah is bitter.

stops.name: Elim
stops.note: Twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees.

stops.name: Rephidim
stops.note: No water again. Moses strikes the rock at Horeb.

stops.name: Mount Sinai
stops.note: They camp before the mountain. Here the covenant is given, and the Law.

stops.name: Kadesh
stops.note: Spies return from Canaan; the people refuse to go up. Forty years of wandering follow.

stops.name: Mount Hor
stops.note: Aaron dies on Mount Hor.

stops.name: Ezion-geber
stops.note: They skirt Edom southward, then turn north along the King's Highway.

stops.name: Mount Nebo
stops.note: Moses climbs Nebo and sees the whole land, but does not enter it.

title: Joshua's Campaign
subtitle: Across the Jordan and into Canaan
intro: The river parts, the walls fall, and a nomadic people becomes a nation in a land.

stops.name: Shittim
stops.note: Joshua rises early and sets out from Shittim to the Jordan.

stops.name: Gilgal
stops.note: The people come up out of the Jordan and camp at Gilgal.

stops.name: Jericho
stops.note: The people shout, the wall falls down flat.

stops.name: Ai
stops.note: After a first defeat, Ai falls to an ambush.

stops.name: Gibeon
stops.note: The Gibeonites ally with Israel; the sun stands still over Gibeon.

stops.name: Hazor
stops.note: In the north Joshua defeats the coalition and burns Hazor.

title: David: Shepherd to King
subtitle: From Bethlehem to Jerusalem
intro: A boy with a sling, a fugitive in caves, a king in a conquered city.

stops.name: Bethlehem
stops.note: Samuel anoints the youngest son of Jesse in the midst of his brothers.

stops.name: Valley of Elah
stops.note: Saul and Israel are encamped in the Valley of Elah, facing the Philistines.

stops.name: Nob
stops.note: Fleeing Saul, David comes to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest.

stops.name: Adullam
stops.note: He escapes to the cave of Adullam; his brothers and four hundred men gather to him.

stops.name: En Gedi
stops.note: In the cave at En-gedi David spares Saul's life.

stops.name: Ziklag
stops.note: Achish gives him Ziklag, which belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.

stops.name: Hebron
stops.note: The men of Judah anoint David king over Judah at Hebron.

stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.note: David takes the stronghold of Zion: the city of David.

title: Exile and Return
subtitle: Jerusalem, Babylon and back
intro: The temple burns, the city is emptied, and a people learns to sing the LORD's song in a strange land. Then, decades later, the road leads home.

stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.note: Nebuzaradan burns the house of the LORD and every great house in Jerusalem.

stops.name: Riblah
stops.note: Zedekiah is brought to the king of Babylon at Riblah and judged there.

stops.name: Carchemish
stops.note: The road to Babylon passes the old battlefield of Carchemish.

stops.name: Babylon
stops.note: By the waters of Babylon, there we sat down and wept.

stops.name: Susa
stops.note: In the Persian capital the story of Esther unfolds.

stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.note: In the second year after their coming, they begin to rebuild the house of God.

title: The Way of Jesus
subtitle: Bethlehem to Calvary
intro: A birth in a small town, a ministry around a lake, and a last road up to Jerusalem.

stops.name: Bethlehem
stops.note: Jesus is born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king.

stops.name: Memphis
stops.note: The family flees by night to Egypt.

stops.name: Nazareth
stops.note: They settle in a city called Nazareth.

stops.name: Jordan
stops.note: Jesus comes from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.

stops.name: Cana
stops.note: A wedding in Cana: water into wine.

stops.name: Capernaum
stops.note: He leaves Nazareth and makes his home in Capernaum by the sea.

stops.name: Sychar
stops.note: At Jacob's well in Samaria he talks with a woman at noon.

stops.name: Bethany
stops.note: Lazarus of Bethany is raised from the dead.

stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.note: He enters the city on a donkey; all the city is stirred.

stops.name: Gethsemane
stops.note: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane.

stops.name: Golgotha
stops.note: They came to a place called Golgotha, which means the place of a skull.

stops.name: Emmaus
stops.note: On the third day two travellers walk to Emmaus with a stranger.

title: Paul's First Journey
subtitle: Cyprus and the Galatian highlands
intro: Sent out by the church at Antioch, Barnabas and Saul sail for Cyprus and then into Asia Minor.

stops.name: Antioch
stops.note: The Holy Spirit says: set apart for me Barnabas and Saul.

stops.name: Seleucia
stops.note: They go down to Seleucia and sail to Cyprus.

stops.name: Salamis
stops.note: They proclaim the word of God in the synagogues at Salamis.

stops.name: Paphos
stops.note: The proconsul Sergius Paulus believes.

stops.name: Perga
stops.note: Paul and his company sail to Perga; John Mark leaves them.

stops.name: Antioch of Pisidia
stops.note: They go into the synagogue on the Sabbath.

stops.name: Iconium
stops.note: A great number of both Jews and Greeks believe.

stops.name: Lystra
stops.note: A lame man is healed; Paul is stoned and left for dead.

stops.name: Derbe
stops.note: The next day he went on with Barnabas to Derbe.

title: Paul's Second Journey
subtitle: Into Europe
intro: A vision in the night at Troas: come over to Macedonia and help us. The gospel crosses into Europe.

stops.name: Antioch
stops.note: Paul chooses Silas and departs, commended by the brothers.

stops.name: Tarsus
stops.note: Through Syria and Cilicia he strengthens the churches.

stops.name: Lystra
stops.note: A disciple named Timothy joins them.

stops.name: Troas
stops.note: A vision: a man of Macedonia pleads, come over and help us.

stops.name: Philippi
stops.note: Lydia, the slave girl, the jailer: the first church in Europe.

stops.name: Thessalonica
stops.note: For three Sabbaths he reasons with them from the Scriptures.

stops.name: Berea
stops.note: The Bereans were more noble: they examined the Scriptures daily.

stops.name: Athens
stops.note: Paul stands in the midst of the Areopagus.

stops.name: Corinth
stops.note: He stays a year and a half, teaching the word of God.

stops.name: Ephesus
stops.note: They come to Ephesus and he reasons with the Jews.

stops.name: Caesarea
stops.note: He lands at Caesarea, goes up and greets the church.

stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.note: Then down to Antioch.

title: Paul's Third Journey
subtitle: Ephesus and farewell
intro: Three years in Ephesus, a riot in the theatre, a collection for Jerusalem, and tearful goodbyes on the beach at Miletus.

stops.name: Ephesus
stops.note: All who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord, Jews and Greeks.

stops.name: Philippi
stops.note: After the uproar Paul departs for Macedonia.

stops.name: Corinth
stops.note: He came to Greece and spent three months there.

stops.name: Troas
stops.note: Eutychus falls asleep during a long sermon, and is raised.

stops.name: Miletus
stops.note: He sends for the elders of Ephesus: you will not see my face again.

stops.name: Tyre
stops.note: They sail to Syria and land at Tyre.

stops.name: Caesarea
stops.note: At the house of Philip the evangelist, a prophet warns of chains.

stops.name: Jerusalem
stops.note: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

title: Paul's Voyage to Rome
subtitle: Storm, shipwreck and the capital
intro: A prisoner appeals to Caesar. Fourteen days of storm; every soul reaches shore.

stops.name: Caesarea
stops.note: Paul and some other prisoners are put in the charge of the centurion Julius.

stops.name: Sidon
stops.note: The next day we put in at Sidon.

stops.name: Fair Havens, Crete
stops.note: With difficulty we came to a place called Fair Havens.

stops.name: Storm at sea
stops.note: A tempestuous wind called the northeaster struck down from the land.

stops.name: Malta
stops.note: After we were brought safely through, we then learned that the island was called Malta.

stops.name: Syracuse
stops.note: Putting in at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

stops.name: Puteoli
stops.note: We came to Puteoli, where we found brothers.

stops.name: Rome
stops.note: And when we came into Rome, Paul was allowed to stay by himself.

title: The Seven Churches
subtitle: From Patmos around Asia Minor
intro: John, exiled on a small island, writes seven letters to seven cities arranged along a Roman postal road.

stops.name: Patmos
stops.note: I was on the island called Patmos on account of the word of God.

stops.name: Ephesus
stops.note: You have abandoned the love you had at first.

stops.name: Smyrna
stops.note: Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.

stops.name: Pergamum
stops.note: I know where you dwell, where Satan's throne is.

stops.name: Thyatira
stops.note: Your latter works exceed the first.

stops.name: Sardis
stops.note: You have the reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

stops.name: Philadelphia
stops.note: I have set before you an open door that no one can shut.

stops.name: Laodicea
stops.note: Because you are lukewarm, I will spit you out of my mouth.
